authoringNotes: Selected training example: Honda FQ650, GP200H. Confirm market variant, nameplate and owner manual before practical work. Physical PDF pages: 6-10 safety, 12-17 controls, 18-20 prechecks, 21-25 starting, 36 stopping, 37-40 maintenance safety/schedule, 41-56 operator checks. Adult trained operator with instructor supervision; younger learners observe stopped isolated machine only. Keep guards, suitable clothing and eye/hearing protection, work outdoors and clear the area. Inspect leaks, oil, filter, fasteners, tines and controls. Start in neutral; fuel valve on; close choke for cold engine, leave open for warm engine; switch on; set throttle per manual; pull starter, return gently, and open choke as engine warms. Demonstrate controls on actual machine. Normal stop: release clutch, neutral, slow throttle, engine switch off, fuel valve off. Emergency: engine switch off. Before tine/belt work stop, cool and disconnect ignition lead. Refuel cool engine outdoors. Complex repairs need qualified technician. Use manual schedule rather than generic intervals.
